summary: A BUSINESSMAN walks along the sidewalk absorbed in his cell phone, "wheeling and dealing," when Neo flashes by and snatches the phone from him. The MAN protests, "What the shit/nobreakspace-- my phone!", and turns to call for help; but he faces forward again, Agent Smith stands there." Meanwhile Neo is in a full-out sprint, dodging every pedestrian and potential Agent, and he flips open the stolen phone and dials long distance.

what_changes.before: Has no phone and is fleeing on foot.
what_changes.after: Possesses the Businessman's cell phone and dials long distance.
what_changes.evidence: snatched by Neo as he flashes by

what_changes.before: An ordinary Businessman calling for help after being robbed.
what_changes.after: Revealed to be Agent Smith when he turns back.
what_changes.evidence: The Man turns to call for help

event_hint.one_line: Neo steals a phone to make a call while fleeing through the city, as a bystander is revealed to be Agent Smith.
